title: Hex Command
description: Turn-based hex grid strategy. Command units, capture ground, defeat the enemy across 5 campaigns.
detailedDescription: Hex Command is a turn-based strategy game built with Godot 4.7. Deploy infantry, tanks, artillery, scouts, and mechs across procedurally generated hex maps. Each unit has unique stats, movement ranges, and attack patterns. Smart AI evaluates positioning, terrain defense, and target priority. Complete 5 missions of increasing difficulty with persistent progress saved via the Galaxy API.
controls: Left-click to select units and hexes. WASD/Arrow keys to pan camera. Mouse wheel to zoom. Use action buttons at bottom of screen.
